verdict.rationale: Docs show configuration/automation changes publish as versioned releases with tracked impact and one-click revert, plus knowledge version history with diffs and per-change authorship. This covers version, review (approval before publish), and rollback for automations specifically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback working in practice, and detail on granular rollback scope (e.g., partial rollback of a single automation vs whole release).
